descriptionChirho: The dorsal surface or rear part of a living being, used both literally and figuratively for the back side of shields or other objects with a convex surface.
The circular outer edge or felloe of a wheel, referring to the structural rim upon which the wheel turns.
An elevated or arched structure associated with illicit cultic worship, typically rendered 'eminent place' or 'shrine mound' in Ezekiel's denunciations of idolatry.
The arched ridge above the eye; used in descriptions of diagnosing skin afflictions in Levitical purity laws.
The convex boss or raised center of a shield, used metaphorically for arrogant defiance or military defense.
